abstract: Maintains landing zone surface certifications and terminal aerodrome night authorization logs
system_message:
You are the Base safety superintendent (BSS), responsible for maintaining landing zone surface certifications and terminal aerodrome night authorization logs, as well as tracking crash rescue standby readiness records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains landing zone surface certifications and terminal aerodrome night authorization logs（SAFE）
information_points.content:
BSS-SAFE-DFV：For the Khumbu Alpine Gorge Corridor, landing zone clearance is verified at the designated casualty evacuation ground coordinate, confirming the touchdown perimeter is free of snowdrift and physical hazards.
BSS-SAFE-9XF：For the Annapurna South Saddle Pass, landing zone clearance is verified at the designated casualty evacuation ground coordinate, confirming the touchdown perimeter is unobstructed by snowdrifts or hazards.
BSS-SAFE-DVI：For the Langtang Ridge Transit Path, landing zone clearance is not verified at the designated casualty evacuation ground coordinate, as hazards or snowdrifts remain within the touchdown perimeter.

information_points.title: Crash rescue standby readiness（FIRE）
information_points.content:
BSS-FIRE-WDY：During the pre-flight emergency drill at the base helipad for the Langtang Ridge Transit Path, the fire rescue deployment drill duration reached full foam suppression readiness in 90 s after siren activation.
BSS-FIRE-63H：During the pre-flight emergency drill at the base helipad for the Annapurna South Saddle Pass, the fire rescue deployment drill duration required 160 s from siren activation to reach full foam suppression readiness.
BSS-FIRE-1L7：During the pre-flight emergency drill at the base helipad for the Khumbu Alpine Gorge Corridor, the fire rescue deployment drill duration was recorded at 120 s from siren activation to full foam suppression readiness.
